title: Para --- For, Pointing Forward
label: ch:para
canDo: I can use para for a destination, a deadline, a recipient or a purpose.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C51-para: produce para ti and para manana, and name the Latin piece inside para that means toward.
payoff.note: Replaces the usual list of twelve uses with one direction. The forward-pointing is inside the word: para is per + ad, and ad is the ad of advance and admit.
